_comment: One entry per file or glob. `match` is an exact path or a glob (*, **, ?, {a,b}); a file takes the most specific entry that matches it. `summarize` folds a glob into one row (photos, videos). `virtual` entries are git-ignored local files that are never scanned. Every directory with files in it at the top level needs a line in `dirs`.

dirs.docs/: Guides for people, and the source of this overview.
dirs.docs/overview/: The overview's template, styles, script and authored text. Edit these, then run npm run build:overview.
dirs.docs/overview/catalog/: The authored half of the overview: descriptions, diagram, flows, API rows, variables, tests, troubleshooting.
dirs.media/: Photos and videos the pages use. Only these file types are served, from /media/.
dirs.model/: Everything about the models, in Python. The website starts this as a separate service and works without it.
dirs.model/terucon_model/: The Python package: the service, its Google client, surface detection and SAM.
dirs.model/terucon_model/segment/: Photo in, named surfaces with exact edges out.
dirs.model/terucon_model/sam/: The optional SAM model. Nothing here loads unless SAM_ENABLED=true.
dirs.model/eval/: Measure how precise the surface edges are, against ground-truth photos.
dirs.model/finetune/: Where fine-tuning work lives: training scripts and data recipes plug in here, next to the code that serves the result.
dirs.model/tests/: The model service's own tests (unittest) and the fake Google they run against.
dirs.model/tests/fixtures/: Sample photos for the model tests.
dirs.pages/: The four built pages, written by tools/build-site.js from pages_original/ and site/patches/. Do not edit by hand.
dirs.pages_original/: Untouched exports from Claude Design. The build starts from these, never from pages/.
dirs.server/config/: Reading .env and the real environment into one settings object.
dirs.server/lib/: Google sign-in and the generateContent proxy, the site map, errors and logging.
dirs.server/middleware/: The guards every request passes through, and the response headers.
dirs.server/routes/: One module per group of routes: pages, media, API, model proxy, docs.
dirs.server/model/: Starting, watching and talking to the Python model service.
dirs.site/: The site as data: site.json, shared HTML components and the JSON patches that turn exports into pages.
dirs.site/patches/: One JSON patch file per page (anchored edits, applied by the build).
dirs.site/patches/snippets/: Code the patches insert (the Design Studio's server mode, the exterior classes).
dirs.tests/: Automated checks: node:test, shared helpers, a dev stack with a fake Google, browser tests.
dirs.tests/js/: node:test suites for the server, the site build and the overview. Run: npm run test:js
dirs.tests/helpers/: A JavaScript fake of Google and small helpers shared by the server tests.
dirs.tests/dev/: A runnable dev stack: the real site against a fake Google, for trying the Design Studio without credentials.
dirs.tests/e2e/: Browser tests that drive Chrome through the real pages. Run: npm run test:e2e
dirs.tests/fixtures/: Data the JavaScript and Python tests both read, so the two implementations cannot drift.
dirs.tools/: Scripts that build, check and run things. The site works without them.

model/.venv/.desc: Optional Python virtual environment for the model service (git-ignored). The website looks here first.

files.desc: The website's entry point. createApp(options) builds the Express app (guards, pages, media, API, model-service proxy); startServer() listens, prints the banner and starts the model service. npm start runs it.
ES-module package. One runtime dependency (express) and every npm script: start, model, build:site, test, build:overview.
Exact versions of the packages npm installed.

Keeps .env, keys, caches, model downloads and node_modules out of git.
The full reference: setup, every setting, how surfaces are found, measured accuracy, known limits.

Generation is deterministic apart from the timestamp, the embedded JSON round-trips, hostile text cannot close the script, and a stale page is detected and rewritten.
